☠️ PGFX LYRICS → VISEME LIP-SYNC
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Properly timed viseme animation using LyricsCreator + WordTimingJsonBuilder + CinemaVisemeRig

CHAIN:
① LyricsCreator: transcribes audio → lyrics text + audio_meta with timed_segments
② WordTimingJsonBuilder: converts phrase-level timed_segments → word-level word_segments
③ CinemaVisemeRig: uses word_segments for accurate phonetic lip-sync timing

CRITICAL: Both connections from LyricsCreator are needed:
  • clean_lyrics_txt (STRING) → CinemaVisemeRig.lyrics  — the words to animate
  • audio_meta (DICT) → WordTimingJsonBuilder.audio_meta — phrase timing from Whisper
  • WordTimingJsonBuilder.word_segments (DICT) → CinemaVisemeRig.audio_meta — word timing

① AUDIO INPUT
Connect a LoadAudio node here
or use the built-in audio
picker in LyricsCreator
③ CONNECTIONS: LyricsCreator.clean_lyrics_txt → CinemaVisemeRig.lyrics | LyricsCreator.audio_meta → WordTimingJsonBuilder.audio_meta | WordTimingJsonBuilder.word_segments → CinemaVisemeRig.audio_meta

HOW TO USE:
1. Place a .wav in ComfyUI/input/ and set the filename in LyricsCreator
2. Set LLM models in LyricsCreator (gpt-4o / gpt-4o-mini, or hf/...)
3. Queue Prompt — LyricsCreator transcribes audio, WordTimingJsonBuilder extracts word timing,
   CinemaVisemeRig generates phonetically accurate lip-sync frames
4. The lip_mask output can be used for compositing with ControlNet or LivePortrait
